_comment: Curated place catalog. All entries are editorial drafts: coordinates are approximate and nothing here has been verified on site. Do not add opening hours, ticket prices or images without a source and licence. Bump 'version' after every edit so the app re-seeds.

destinations.name: Da Nang
destinations.description: Coastal city on the Han River with long sandy beaches, the Son Tra Peninsula and the Marble Mountains nearby.

destinations.name: Hoi An
destinations.description: Riverside town known for its preserved Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, plus nearby craft villages and beaches.

places.description: Dragon-shaped bridge across the Han River, lit up in the evening. A fire and water display is reported on some weekend nights; check the current schedule locally.
